act3/corruption_event.title: Pulse of Corruption
act3/corruption_event.body:
A green **crystal** pulses. The dungeon's echo answers — a pulse that asks no permission to whisper.

The air **vibrates** in your teeth; for an instant, **Morvayn** sounds like a tally-word, not a name — as if someone below **measured** how many hearts still beat in favor of denial.

choices.preview: Let the pulse in — the dungeon signs its name on you.

choices.text: Pull back before the pulse finds you whole
choices.preview: Your body keeps humming; the price is nerve, not skin.

choices.text: Turn your back — pretend the green does not exist
choices.preview: Nothing changes on the map; maybe something changes in you.

act3/cult_passage.title: Cult Passage
act3/cult_passage.body: The torn map **whispers** where to turn — in a niche, **bones** bound with copper wire and a **bell shard** driven in like a nail. The **narrow** passage smells of burnt tallow.

choices.text: Leave a coin in the niche — ask passage from the Bell's ear
choices.preview: Gold and learning · cult trust mark (once).
diaryTexts: The copper licked the coin and the air grew heavier — as if the tunnel had closed its ledger.

choices.text: Take the shortcut without profaning the niche
choices.preview: Leave the foreign rite where it lies — the map already lied for you.

choices.text: Rip out the shard and wire — the cult notices, the Vigil too
choices.preview: Symbol and proof in your pocket; haste and enmity.
diaryTexts: I stole the Third Bell shard from the niche — the order's silence will cost dear.

act3/descent.title: Descent into Deep Silence
act3/descent.body:
The stairs **sink** and the **green pulse** beats with your heart — each flight steals **noise** until only damp stone remains. **No fire** here counts as shelter.

With the **Torn Map**, a shortcut opens that honest maps do not show.

choices.preview: Down there, the water whispers promises no one confirms.
Ink traces and fear — a path honest maps erase.
choices.lockedHint: You need the rumor-map in inventory and level 6 to force that shortcut.

choices.preview: Something pulls beneath the skin; playing deaf costs more each time.
choices.lockedHint: At level 6 corruption stops being rumor — it becomes encounter.

choices.preview: Fix the smell before silence devours it.

choices.text: Listen to what Mira says of the smell and the silence
choices.preview: A voice that already signed with the depths.

act3/diary_trigger.title: Diary Entry
act3/diary_trigger.body: A sensation **etches** itself into the diary.
onEnterDiaryTexts: The air smells of rotten copper.

act3/encounters/cult_ambush_scene.title: Cultist Ambush
act3/encounters/cult_ambush_scene.body: **Cultists** were already waiting. Their advantage — the dice will show.

act3/encounters/cult_patrol_scene.title: Blind Messenger Patrol
act3/encounters/cult_patrol_scene.body: A **messenger** without eyes guides two acolytes down the corridor. The bell bound to his wrist marks your time in beats of condemnation.

choices.text: Strike before they ring the bell

act3/encounters/stone_combat_intro.title: Stone Against Flesh
act3/encounters/stone_combat_intro.body: Stone **against** flesh. Three layers of armor before the real wound.

act3/encounters/vigil_hunter_scene.title: Lost Vigil Hunter
act3/encounters/vigil_hunter_scene.body: A Vigil **hunter**, covered in lime and soot, watches the passage as if still obeying orders from a dead commander.

choices.text: Face the hunter in the dark

act3/flee_cult.title: Flight — hoods that laugh
act3/flee_cult.body:
The **hoods** do not run — they **float**. You run like someone who still has **human lungs**.

A **blade** cuts the air too close to your ear; another **scores** your pride without touching skin — humiliation is their weapon.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I fled the ambush. The Third Bell's echo stayed at the nape of my neck like a dirty nail.

act3/hub_depths.title: Heart of the Depths
act3/hub_depths.body:
**Silent** depths. **Morvayn** is not far — his silence was **politics** before it was magic.

You cannot **camp** here as at the crossroads: the underworld charges continuous presence, and your breath becomes rare **coin**.

choices.preview: Move through the corridors; stress rises and encounters may happen.
Chapter 4 — confrontation with Morvayn; the throne waits.
choices.lockedHint: You need level 10, to defeat the stone guardian, and to reach the gate in the depths.

choices.preview: Runes, golem, and proof before the throne.
The silence is yours now — runes and niche, without the golem.

choices.text: Follow ash and rope — interrupted messenger
choices.preview: Stealth or force; Vigil or Circle charge for the dispatch.

choices.text: Listen to pipes beneath the stone
choices.preview: Luck; success gives a clue, failure costs supply.

choices.text: Descend to the forgotten shrine (stone seal)
choices.preview: Ancient seal; class defines how it opens.
choices.lockedHint: You need level 7 to locate the cracked stone veil — before that, the shrine remains rumor only.

choices.text: Speak with the cultist crossing the corridor
choices.preview: Pact, refusal, or steel; reputation shifts either way.
choices.lockedHint: The cultist only approaches those heavy enough in the depths — level 9.

choices.preview: Climb to the crossroads; chapter 2 on the story map.

act3/lore/cult_negotiate.title: Pact Without Altar
act3/lore/cult_negotiate.body:
**Low voice**: *"I bring a simple contract — you descend, we write the right name in the pipes. In return, **silence** outside the tunnel."*

The **cultist** holds an old coin — a **clerk**, not a fanatic. Behind him, two others **record** your answer. The **Circle** pays so the **Vigil** will not know what you will see below.

choices.text: Show the Third Bell signet — ask favor at the margin of the contract
choices.preview: Gold and experience · cult recognition (once).
diaryTexts: The agent tilted his head like someone confirming a balance: the Bell remembers who pays twice.

choices.text: Accept the offer: pain for whisper
choices.preview: Circle +1, Vigil −1; gold in advance.
diaryTexts: I accepted coin I cannot return — and a name I will hear in the pipes when I descend further.

choices.text: [+] Refuse with the penitent's posture — return the coin intact
choices.preview: Vigil +1, faith +1; he withdraws, but records your face.
diaryTexts: I refused without theater; the cultist kept the coin like someone keeping a debt — so did I.

choices.text: Refuse — the Vigil recognizes your silence
choices.preview: Vigil +1; the cultist laughs dryly and vanishes.
diaryTexts: I did not say 'no' — I said the name of who sent me. That was enough for his silence.

choices.text: Rehearse each clause in a minimal voice — verbal confrontation (draft)
choices.preview: Tension and rolls; victory closes the pact as offered; failure leads to steel.
Immediate combat; no bargaining.
The cultist vanished into the pipes; the echo of the gesture remains.

act3/lore/cult_negotiate_verbal_fail.title: Pact Without Altar (steel)
act3/lore/cult_negotiate_verbal_fail.body: [DRAFT] The bargain **breaks**. The agent whistles through his teeth; behind him, the pipe reminds you that **silence** also has **teeth**.

choices.preview: Immediate combat; no bargaining.

act3/lore/cult_negotiate_verbal_win.title: Pact Without Altar (word)
act3/lore/cult_negotiate_verbal_win.body: [DRAFT] The agent steps back half a pace. The coin disappears into his sleeve like someone closing a ledger. The contract was **spoken** — the tunnel still demands proof, but not **at this** turn.

choices.text: Descend with the contract in your head

onEnterDiaryTexts: [DRAFT] The agent closed the tone without altar — bargain in minimal voice; the pipe deferred its teeth.

act3/messenger_cold_trail.title: Messenger Trail
act3/messenger_cold_trail.body:
Fresh **ash** under your boots and **rope** cut in haste: someone dragged a body here and then **argued** with the tunnel.

Below, a **tallow light** — two **cultists** counting coins over an empty holster. The holster bears a **Vigil** crest scraped away: a message that never reached the beacon.

choices.preview: Avoid alarm — or fall into ambush.
Cultists in their den; steel speaks first.

act3/messenger_combat_intro.title: Cult in the Den
act3/messenger_combat_intro.body: Metal **wakes** before you — it does not matter: there is no conversation left that is not **blade**.

act3/messenger_payoff.title: Dead Man's Inventory
act3/messenger_payoff.body: In the holster: a **name list** with the stamp scraped off and a crooked **sentinel brooch**. You can return it to the **order** or turn it into **coin** on the network — each charges a different kind of silence.

choices.text: Leave the brooch and list where the Vigil will find them
choices.preview: Vigil +1 · little gold · the order thanks in silence.
diaryTexts: I returned to the beacon what the cult stole — without glory, with rent paid.

choices.text: Pass the package to the Circle — price and anonymity
choices.preview: Circle +1 · more gold · +1 corruption
diaryTexts: The Circle pays better for secrets than the Vigil pays for honor — and I charged the interest on my skin.

act3/messenger_stealth_roll.title: Silence in the Corridor
act3/messenger_stealth_roll.body: The stone **judges** every weight. A creak now is sentence.
act3/messenger_stealth_roll.skillCheckLabel: Crawl without making your armor groan

act3/mira_descent_whisper.title: Whisper on the Descent
act3/mira_descent_whisper.body: **Mira** tilts her head without looking at you: "Here silence is not peace — it is **truce** between whoever rules the ceiling and whoever rules the floor. If you hear your name in the dark, do not be the first to answer."

choices.preview: The echo does not grow lighter — only more familiar.

act3/pipes_whisper.title: Pipes
act3/pipes_whisper.body: Between green bronze **pipes**, the air **scrapes** a melody — voices from above, distorted, speaking **toll** and **descent** as if they were the same word.
act3/pipes_whisper.luckCheckLabel: Hear the rumor in the pipe before the stone swallows it

act3/pipes_whisper_fail.title: Pipe That Bites
act3/pipes_whisper_fail.body: The **condensation** runs like acid; coughs rise from the pipe and the stone **bites** your glove. You lost breath and **supply** learning what you already knew: the depths **charge** for curiosity.

choices.text: Pull your hand free and retreat

onEnterDiaryTexts: The pipe was too hot — I burned time and supply listening to garbage.

act3/pipes_whisper_ok.title: Useful Echoes
act3/pipes_whisper_ok.body: You catch **one whole sentence** before the wind cuts off: *"… close the grate at the fourth stroke…"* — not poetry; **instruction**.

choices.text: Write it down and move on

onEnterDiaryTexts: The pipe lied about tone, but not meaning: someone above pays not to know who descends.

act3/secret/forgotten_shrine.title: Forgotten Shrine
act3/secret/forgotten_shrine.body:
Behind a cracked stone **veil** opens an antechamber that was not on the map — low slabs, **runes** sealed with lead, still water that **mirrors** without reflecting.

At the center, a greater **rune**. No altar — only **promises** folded between the joints. One would **open** if you touched it.

choices.text: Touch the central rune — remember silence before the name
choices.preview: Faith answers faith; the seal opens slowly.
diaryTexts: The shrine accepted me — not as heroic visit, but as someone who closed the door before leaving.

choices.text: [*] Whisper the contained formula — listen to what the seal keeps
choices.preview: Mind over rune; knowledge costs one supply.
diaryTexts: The rune did not ask for blood — it asked for attention. The notebook grew by a page I am not sure was mine.

choices.text: [!] Force it open — break the seal with steel
choices.preview: Steel against silence; gold and cost.
diaryTexts: I broke what asked for patience; the echo closed over me like a collar.

choices.text: Withdraw from the shrine without touching
choices.preview: Pretend you saw nothing.
diaryTexts: Some shrines ask to be left in peace — I pretended obedience for today.

choices.preview: The seal remembers you as you remember it.

act3/stone_corridor.title: Rune Corridor
act3/stone_corridor.body: Runes ignite. A funeral **golem** blocks the throne.

choices.text: Return to the heart of the depths

act3/stone_guard_victory.title: The Guardian Yields
act3/stone_guard_victory.body: The stone **cracks** with a dry snap. The corridor falls silent, as if the tomb itself accepted your passage.
onEnterDiaryTexts: The guardian fell; the runes on the passage lost their pulse.

act3/stone_niche_loot.title: Votive Niche
act3/stone_niche_loot.body: Between two funeral plaques, you find a niche with cold coins and dry resin. The altar protests in silence, but not enough to stop you.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I scraped ancient coins from a votive niche before the dust swallowed them again.

act3/stone_rune_trial.title: Pulse of the Runes
act3/stone_rune_trial.body: The marks on the wall begin to **vibrate** when you bring your hand close. The corridor demands focus: either you tame the old rhythm, or it invades your nerves.
act3/stone_rune_trial.skillCheckLabel: Match your breath to the stone's rhythm

act3/stone_rune_trial_fail.title: Echo in the Bones
act3/stone_rune_trial_fail.body: The wall's answer comes as a dry shock through your tendons. Your steps fall half a beat behind.

choices.text: Pull back and catch your breath

onEnterDiaryTexts: I failed the runes' measure; my legs tremble with a cursed delay.

act3/stone_rune_trial_success.title: Rhythm Tamed
act3/stone_rune_trial_success.body: The runes' glow drops one tone. The weight in your skull eases, and every sound in the tomb seems to arrive in order.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I tuned to the runes' pulse; for a little while, I think with more clarity.

act3/well_fail.title: Well's Deception
act3/well_fail.body: You believe the reflection. Something in the next room **prepares** a surprise for you.

act3/well_lies.title: The Well That Lied
act3/well_lies.body: The **Well That Lied** reflects a map that does not match the walls — a lie from whoever profits from **every** detour: not the well that errs, but the hand that carved the map for another pocket.
act3/well_lies.skillCheckLabel: Discern the map carved in stone

act3/well_success.title: Truth in the Mirror
act3/well_success.body: You see the **trick**: displaced mirror. The real path opens to the left.
